title: Project Manager(Telecom)
description:
**Project Manager – Telecom Infrastructure**

**Company:** Spectra Televentures

**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Experience:** 6 – 7 Years

**About Spectra Televentures**

Spectra Televentures is a premier telecommunications infrastructure solutions provider. We deliver end\-to\-end, integrated infrastructure deployment and management—spanning Active Infrastructure, Passive Infrastructure, and Optical Fiber Cable (OFC) networks—for leading telecom operators and enterprise clients across India.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a high\-performing **Project Manager – Telecom** with 6 to 7 years of core domain experience to join our team in Gurugram. Serving as the primary right hand to the **Deputy General Manager (DGM) – Telecom**, you will be responsible for driving site\-level execution, resource planning, project timelines, and operational delivery across active, passive, and fiber deployment tracks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Executive Support to DGM:** Act as the strategic and operational right hand to the DGM \- Telecom, assisting in schedule tracking, risk management, client reporting, and cross\-functional team alignment.
* **Turnkey Project Execution:** Manage daily operations and end\-to\-end rollout for active equipment (BTS, microwave, RAN), passive setups (towers, power systems, civil foundation), and fiber networks (OFC laying, blowing, splicing, and FTTH).
* **Vendor \& Field Operations Management:** Direct contractors, field engineers, and OEMs to ensure site execution meets technical specifications, quality standards, and strict timelines.
* **Timeline \& Budget Governance:** Track milestone progress using project management tools, manage project budgets, mitigate delays, and resolve site\-level bottlenecks proactively.
* **Client \& Regulatory Coordination:** Coordinate with telecom client project teams, local authorities, and regulatory bodies to ensure smooth site acquisition, row permissions, and operational compliance.
* **Quality \& SLA Compliance:** Oversee site audits, acceptance testing (AT), and handover processes to ensure complete alignment with SLA commitments and safety norms.

**Requirements \& Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 6 to 7 years of hands\-on project management experience in telecom infrastructure execution.
* **Technical Expertise:** Proven, hands\-on operational background in all three areas: **Active Infrastructure**, **Passive Infrastructure**, and **Fiber Networks (OFC)**.
* **Education:** B.Tech / B.E. in Electronics \& Communication (ECE), Electrical, or Telecommunications Engineering. PMP/PRINCE2 certification is a strong plus.
* **Location:** Based in or willing to work full\-time from **Gurugram, Haryana**.
* **Core Skills:** Strong leadership, data\-driven reporting, structured project tracking, and exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

**What We Offer**

* High\-visibility role working closely alongside executive leadership (DGM).
* Competitive salary and performance\-linked incentives.
* Fast\-track career growth within a leading telecom infrastructure ecosystem.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: SAP Project & Operations Lead
description:
**Purpose of Position:**

The SAP Project \& Operations Lead serves as the primary functional focal point across Project System (PS), Plant Maintenance (PM), Production Planning (PP), and Quality Management (QM) within the Group\-wide SAP S/4HANA environment

The role ensures stable operational processes, supports continuous improvement, leads solution design, and enables best\-practice process adoption across all operating companies.

This position serves as the primary functional authority for operations\-related modules and works closely with business stakeholders, SAP partners, and internal CoE teams to ensure efficient and reliable SAP\-enabled business processes.

The role also provides leadership, mentoring and functional direction to Associate Consultants and contributes to the long\-term enhancement and standardization of SAP operations processes across the Group.

**Key Responsibilities \& Accountabilities:**

**SAP Functional Ownership**

1\. Lead functional ownership of PM, PS, PP, and QM modules across the SAP S/4HANA Group instance.

2\. Manage solution architecture and ensure alignment to SAP best practices and business process standards.

3\. Lead Fit\-to\-Standard, solution design, configuration review, and functional specification development.

**Operational Excellence \& Support**

4\. Ensure stable system operations, manage L2/L3 incidents, perform root\-cause analysis, and resolve cross\-functional issues.

5\. Oversee the associate’s daily support work, ensuring timely resolution of operational tickets and adherence to CoE processes.

6\. Monitor integration touchpoints with MM, FICO, HR, Procurement, EHS, and SCM to maintain data and process consistency.

**Enhancements, Change Management, and Optimization**

7\. Identify and lead enhancement initiatives across PM, PS, PP, and QM to improve performance, usability, and compliance.

8\. Develop functional specifications, coordinate with technical teams (ABAP, BTP, Integration), and validate delivered solutions.

9\. Lead the testing lifecycle (SIT/UAT), including developing test scripts, validating results, and ensuring quality assurance.

**Business Engagement \& Governance**

10\. Collaborate with business owners (Operations, Engineering, Projects, Manufacturing, HSE, QA) to analyse pain points and improvement opportunities.

11\. Define and maintain process documentation, SOPs, functional specifications, solution documentation, and training materials.

12\. Ensure compliance with audit requirements, internal controls, change management processes, and system governance.

**Reporting \& Analytics Alignment**

13\. Work closely with the SAP Analytics \& Reporting Consultant to support operational dashboards, KPIs, and reporting for operations functions.

14\. Validate data accuracy for operational KPIs across PP, PM, PS, and QM.

**Leadership \& CoE Development**

15\. Guide and mentor the Associate Consultants assigned to operations modules.

16\. Contribute to SAP roadmap discussions and future CoE capability development.

17\. Represent the operations domain in Group SAP governance forums (SteerCo, Change Advisory Board, etc.)

**Principal Challenges:**

1\. Managing complex integration across PM, PS, PP, and QM within a single SAP instance used by multiple companies across the group.

2\. Balancing heavy operational support with enhancement demands and strategic improvement initiatives.

3\. Standardizing processes across operating companies with varying maturity levels.

4\. Ensuring strong change control and avoiding disruption to mission\-critical operations.

5\. Managing cross\-functional dependencies and ensuring alignment between technical and functional teams.

**Minimum Academic \& Professional Qualifications**:

1\. Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Operations Management, or an equivalent field.

2\. SAP S/4HANA certification in PM, PP, or PS is required (multiple certifications are advantageous).

3\. Proven experience with SAP Activate methodology, including fit\-to\-standard analysis, testing cycles, and deployment phases, is required

4\. Strong understanding of manufacturing, maintenance, project management, and quality process cycles.

5\. Additional certifications or learning in process architecture, or solution governance is an advantage

**Minimum Work Experience:** 

1\. 7 to 10 years of hands\-on experience delivering and supporting SAP PM, PS, PP, and QM modules.

2\. Proven experience leading solution design, configuration oversight, testing, and deployment in at least two full\-cycle SAP implementations or major rollout projects (S/4HANA preferred).

3\. Strong track record in stabilizing operations, resolving cross\-module issues, and improving system performance.

4\. Experience working directly with senior business stakeholders and managing functional expectations.

5\. Prior experience guiding junior consultants or support analysts is strongly preferred.

6\. Exposure to SAP BTP integrations, Fiori apps, digital maintenance, and manufacturing execution systems is a plus.

**Skills \& Competencies Required:**

· **Technical \& Functional Skills**

1\. Deep functional expertise in PM, PS, PP, and QM with proven configuration and solution design knowledge.

2\. Strong understanding of cross\-functional processes (MM, FICO, HR, Procurement, and SCM).

3\. Proficiency in defining functional specifications, validating technical development, and coordinating with technical teams.

4\. Strong understanding of S/4HANA master data (materials, equipment, BOM, routing, WBS, work centers).

5\. Experience in troubleshooting performance, integration, and data integrity issues.

6\. Familiarity with process automation, workflow, and enhancement frameworks.

7\. Knowledge of SAP role/authorization framework for operational areas.

· **Soft Skills**

1\. Strong leadership qualities with the ability to mentor and guide an associate.

2\. Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage senior stakeholders.

3\. Highly analytical and structured problem\-solving ability.

4\. Strong documentation, process mapping, and presentation skills.

5\. Ability to manage multiple workstreams and prioritize under pressure.

6\. High level of accountability and ownership of module performance.

7\. Continuous improvement mindset and willingness to adopt new SAP innovations.

8\. Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset with the ability to break down complex SAP issues.

**QHSSE Responsibilities:**

1\. Comply with all organizational Quality, Health, Safety, Security, and Environment (QHSSE) policies and procedures.

2\. Ensure that all SAP support activities follow documented quality standards and audit requirements.

3\. Proactively identify and report any risks or non\-compliances that may impact system integrity or business operations.

4\. Maintain secure handling of system access, data privacy, and sensitive business information.

5\. Promote a safe and compliant working environment through accountability, awareness, and continuous improvement.

* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Gurugram, Haryana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* SAP Experience

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* SAP : 5 years (Required)

* The opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling, tech\-driven environment shaping the future of mobility.
* High\-impact ownership of governance and compliance execution across operating regions.
* Broad cross\-functional exposure to Safety, Operations, Ground Operations, and external stakeholders.
* A learning and development budget and clear growth exposure into broader operations and program management roles.

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. description:

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Technical Program Manager
Job Description: Senior Specialist, Product Development, Digital Transformation \& Optimization  

  

Overview:  

Mastercard is a global technology company. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making payment and data transactions safe, simple, smart, and successful. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  

  

The Digital Transformation and Optimization team is part of Core Solutions. We are responsible for optimizing eCommerce solutions and for driving transaction authorization improvement for digital transactions globally. We do this by being a consumer centric for our products and services and being relevant in all consumer money flows.
  

  

The Role:  

* Have good understanding of hybrid application integrations, analytical tools to measure and track customer experience, like Mixtiles, and Project management frameworks/ tools like GIT, copilot and Jira
* Responsible for identifying, analyzing, developing, and bringing solutions to market that meet customer needs through supporting stories, feature management and project planning, helping to make solid product decisions and deliver value
* Drive product evolution with a focus on data science, engineering and business impact by helping to maintain the product backlog, and prioritize requirements
* Provide Operational support of new products where authorization recommendations are delivered from an AI engine to an Mastercard global application
* Act as a Program Admin to support Mastercard product governance tools and services (Studio, Architecture Reviews, AI governance, Compliance and Data Security, etc.)
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including engineering, data science, operations, and design to deliver scalable solutions that enhance product connectivity, data flow, and performance insight
* Continuously innovate and explore new approaches, tools, techniques, and technologies to solve business problems
* Stay updated on emerging trends in integration technologies (e.g., AI ML model \& and data analytics platforms (e.g., Thoughtspot, Power BI)

  

Candidates based in India only  

  

ALL ABOUT YOU  

The candidate should demonstrate:  

* Must have a minimum of 5 years of experience in technical product management and project management
* Passion for all things digital and intrinsic curiosity to understand new technology like Artificial Intelligence, Cloud solutions
* Entrepreneurial spirit and global mindset with a passion for learning and using data to solve large scale business problems
* Experience using project management tools like Git, Jira, Aha, etc is preferable
* Excellent communication \& influencing skills to work with internal and external stakeholders; ability to articulate problem statements, opportunity areas and complex data models
* Excellent project management and execution skills, with strong problem solving, highly analytical, quantitative communication and organizational skills
* Create and maintain material in support of product development and management: business cases, product roadmaps, success metrics, etc.
* Good to have experience with Enterprise Business Intelligence Platform/Data platforms
* Ability to articulate the business value of products and actively participate in sales enablement efforts
* Proven success in interacting with stakeholders to understand technical needs and ensure analyses and solutions effectively meet their requirements

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
